name: Sitojaure-Aktse
estimatedTime: 3-4 hours by STF; Naturkartan lists 4-5 hours

difficulty.label: Moderate short mountain stage with required boat logistics, steep climb and steep descent
difficulty.source: STF and Naturkartan describe an easy first walking section from Svine/Svijnne through birch forest and plankway/wetland context, then a steep climb to open mountain, scarce water on the open fell and a steep descent through old-growth forest to Aktse.
caveats: No formal official difficulty grade was found.
The day depends on a pre-booked Sitojaure-Svine/Svijnne boat before the walking line.
Official distance and time evidence conflicts across STF and Naturkartan.
The Skierfe side trip turns the day into a much longer, more exposed route and changes rules because it partly enters Sarek.

notes: Official direction is Sitojaure to Aktse.
STF treats the Sitojaure-Svine/Svijnne boat as transport before the hike; hiking begins at Svine/Svijnne.
Naturkartan BD63/site 12893 excludes the Sitojaure boat and is stored reverse from Aktse/Lajtavrre north boat landing toward Svijnne.
OSM relation 18864488 includes hut-to-hut continuity with the Sitojaure ferry way.
The next Kungsleden stage toward Parte begins with the separate Laitaure boat/rowboat crossing; keep that as section-11 connector metadata.

commuteAccess.summary: Neither endpoint has direct road or public transport. Sitojaure is reached from the north via Saltoluokta and the previous hiking stage, and the section itself begins with the pre-booked Sitojaure-Svijnne/Svine private boat. Aktse is roadless; nearest roadhead access is Sitoalvsbron by private car/taxi and walking or boat shortcut, while Kvikkjokk/Murjek are longer south-side transit contexts.

The required section-start boat must be pre-booked.

rulesSummary: Tenting, hiking, fires, berry/mushroom picking, snowmobiling on well-snow-covered ground and fishing/hunting under applicable law are allowed.
Damaging plant or animal life is not allowed.
Fire bans and local rules override general permission.

protectedAreas.name: Sarek National Park / Laponia boundary at Aktse and Skierfe
protectedAreas.overlapConfidence: high for boundary-adjacent; medium for exact route-line crossing without GIS overlay
rulesSummary: STF says Aktse/Kungsleden pass just outside Sarek and the next stage enters Sarek; Swedish National Parks says Aktse is on the boundary of Sarek.
Skierfe side trip partly enters Sarek and changes rules.
Dogs cannot accompany the Skierfe side trip per Naturkartan; dogs are only allowed in Sarek under limited conditions and on Kungsleden exceptions.
Drones in Sarek require County Administrative Board permission.
Hunting and fishing are prohibited in Sarek.

dogs.summary: Keep dogs under strict control in reindeer-herding country. If entering Sarek/Skierfe side-trip terrain, dog rules become much stricter; Naturkartan says dogs cannot accompany Skierfe side trip.

reindeer.summary: Sitojaure is by a Sami settlement; Sarek/Laponia regulations prohibit intentionally disturbing grazing reindeer or reindeer gathering/moving. Keep distance from herds, work areas and fences.

huntingAndFishing.summary: In Sarek, hunting and fishing are prohibited. 2026 Jokkmokkskortet lists Sitojaure and Laitaure as winter-only fishing waters from January 1-May 2 and October 1-December 31, so do not assume summer fishing is allowed on this section's lakes.

drones.summary: Drone flying in Sarek requires County Administrative Board permission. National park regulations also restrict aircraft start/landing and flight below 2,000 ft without approval.

currentClosuresAndWarnings.summary: Lansstyrelsen stopped checking winter routes because spring warmth sharply worsened snow/ice; open water and impossible crossings reported. County-wide, not section-specific.
currentClosuresAndWarnings.sectionImpact: Spring/winter/shoulder-season caution; not a summer closure.

currentClosuresAndWarnings.summary: Earlier county-wide warning about weak ice, water on lake ice, thin/breaking ice in flowing water and variable snow depth.

currentClosuresAndWarnings.source: Lansstyrelsen Aktuellt i fjallen, Sarek and Ultevis pages
currentClosuresAndWarnings.summary: No Sitojaure-Aktse-specific closure/reroute found on current pages; Sarek and Ultevis pages showed no current site news.
currentClosuresAndWarnings.sectionImpact: Absence of web notice is not field confirmation; recheck close to travel.

hazards: Pre-booked boat dependency and no rowboats at Sitojaure since 2021.
No cell coverage at Svijnne berth; book/call before leaving Aktse if travelling northbound.
Weather/whitecaps can delay or cancel boat crossings.
Partly boardwalked/wet first walking section; 2023 report described some old/dilapidated boardwalks.
Steep climb to open fell and steep descent to Aktse.
Water is limited on the open fell; carry enough from lower birch forest.
Skierfe side trip is long/exposed and should be attempted only in good weather.

conditionReports.caveat: Useful boat-reliability signal, not official schedule.

conditionReports.summary: Reported growing Sitojaure boat demand and multiple morning boat trips; also saw Sitojaure hut fully booked by a group.
Reported Telia coverage at Sitojaure, no coverage at Aktse in one report, and some coverage around Skierfe/top and route toward Sitojaure.

sourceContradictions.details: STF route stage lists 10 km / 3-4 h; Naturkartan lists 11.5 km / 4-5 h; an STF FAQ says Sitojaure-Aktse 9 km; STF Aktse facility says Sitojaure is about 13 km north of Aktse; AllTrails lists 9.7 km and Distant North says 9 km hiking plus 4 km lake.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Use STF route stage 10 km / 3-4 h as display baseline, keep Naturkartan 11.5 km / 4-5 h and computed geometry lengths for QA, and treat boat wait/crossing separately.

sourceContradictions.details: Official/STF text starts with boat transport before hiking; Naturkartan BD63 excludes the boat; OSM relation 18864488 includes the ferry.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Model the boat explicitly as required connector/access metadata or typed transport segment, not as walking line. Use Naturkartan for walking geometry and OSM for QA/fallback if source policy permits.

sourceContradictions.details: Naturkartan BD63 is stored Aktse/Laitaure north landing to Svijnne and excludes exact hut endpoints; OSM is Sitojaure-to-Aktse and hut-proximate.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Reverse Naturkartan for official order, keep STF hut endpoints as POIs and document the ferry/landing gaps.

sourceContradictions.details: Route-geometry lane found a working Naturkartan GPX; official-source lane reported no public GPX and API publish_gpx=false.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Record GPX as found-working on 2026-04-29 but re-test before import and resolve source/capture policy.

sourceContradictions.details: STF uses Kaskajaure/Kabtajaure and Svine; Naturkartan uses Gasskajaure/Gabddajavrre and Svijnne; Lansstyrelsen uses Sijddojavrre/Sitojaure for discontinued rowing route.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Keep aliases in research; use source-specific spelling in source citations and a stable normalized connector label Sitojaure-Svijnne/Svine.

sourceContradictions.details: Main route appears just outside or boundary-adjacent to Sarek near Aktse, while Skierfe side trip enters Sarek; exact route-line crossing needs GIS overlay.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Do not apply Skierfe/Sarek stricter rules to main stage without overlay, but document them for side-trip and boundary context.

sourceContradictions.details: STF lists June 19-September 14 until further notice; operator-visible evidence was still Season 2025 and 2026 times/fares were not confirmed.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Treat as required but date-sensitive connector; recheck operator site/phone before publication.
